title: A random cat dude breaks into your home!

posts.author: Aker
posts.body:
Hello! This is my first time actually engaging with the RPG Maker community, so bear with me because I might ask stupid questions from time to time. I've known about the Maker series for about twelve years now and messed with VX Ace back in 2013, but it wasn't until the last two years that I finally started getting into game development.
I've been making music for over a decade, being self taught and doing my best to make that work. I've tried a few different programs for getting started, but ultimately found that MZ was a good starting point for what I wanna do. Not really looking to make a big name for myself. Just had a desire to do game development as a passion for the longest time and finally decided to see it through.
I'm kinda shy and stuff because people can be stinky, but I'm pretty chill. I will warn y'all ahead of time however that all of my games are gonna be fairly mature on some level because I am an adult. Basic stuff like blood and gore, drug use and swearing will be in them, and depending on the project, it could be more intense, but I've seen how to tag those projects and have the common sense not to show anything that isn't PG13, so it shouldn't be an issue at all.
But yeah, it's good to meet you all and I hope you have a nice day!

posts.author: Aker
posts.body:
Thanks! This was definitely a nice first response. I've always been kinda nervous about forums, but the RPG Maker one always seemed to be fairly level headed from what I've seen, so it always seemed like an easier one for me to get into.

posts.author: Ulqiuo
posts.body:
Howdy AkerHasAwakened! Welcome to the forum. Good to hear you're dipping your feet here! The journey begins with a single step after all - take your time, you'll find people here're quite chill too. I joined a couple weeks ago or so n' people've been nothing but kind so far.
Excellent to hear you're into music creation too! It's definitely a huge part to any project. RPG Maker's an excellent program to dip your feet in game creation. Feel free to ask any questions in the forum's categories when needed, and even for feedback on things.
Looking forward to see what you come up with! Have fun!

Will do! I have a fairly fun project in the works right now. I have some music, sprites and a bit of the world prepared, but it'll be a bit before I can show anything off. What I
can
say however is that it'll be making use of the ARPG plugin set, some quality of life things like 3D sound sources and proximity sensors and even Banjo-Kazooie style voices, but that's all I'm ready to reveal at the moment. It's gonna be my first project, but I intend on making it a good one and I have plenty of time to make it. Stay tuned!

posts.author: Ulqiuo
posts.body:
From what you've spoken of so far it sounds like it's shaping up to be a right banger of a game! Especially liking the thought of the ARPG and 3D sounds. I wish you the best; let us all know how you're getting on down the line when you're comfortable! I can't be the only one eager to see what you produce.
Take care!
